Regression test: tests/unit/tls_p256_retry drives the full path (seeds K/V, clobbers r0..rt, advances once) and requires the RFC 6979 h.3 nonce 8E83DC49...8FDB, computed with an independent implementation from the A.2.5 key; it fails on the pre-audit layout.
